newsitem.title: ESTONIA: MUUGA CONTAINER TERMINAL PROJECT LAUNCHED-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: MUUGA CONTAINER TERMINAL PROJECT LAUNCHED-REPORT.

text.p: The Port of Tallinn and Ferry Terminal have launched a joint project worth 250 million kroons for the construction of a container terminal in Muuga Port, newspaper Aripaev said on Thursday.
The container terminal project, which will take several years, will have a final capacity of 150,000 TEUs a year, Sergei Artjomov, head of Ferry Terminal told the newspaper.
The agreement includes the port providing the substructure and Ferry Terminal providing the superstructure for the project.
No agreement on the division of investments has yet been reached, with the project planned to take up to four years for completion, the newspaper added.
Ferry Terminal has been operating in the Tallinn deep water port for the last three and a half years.
